newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil firms, diesel shows continued strength.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil firms, diesel shows continued strength.

text.p: NWE gas oil nudged higher on Friday as futures played catch-up to crude and diesel showed its strength once again.
May IPE gas oil ended 75 cents higher at $165.50.

Diesel premiums moved higher as tight supplies started to bite. Offers of May IPE +$14.00 cif NWE heard yesterday were quickly withdrawn once a bid of $13.50 came into the market. Traders said nothing had been concluded although a swap of $12.50 for May was done.

Diesel also gained support from news that Germany's oil stocks agency, the EBV, was expected to tender to buy 250,000 tonnes of diesel next week. The EBV is also looking to acquire 250,000 tonnes of jet, traders said.
FOD and DIN had a busier end to a quiet week with an exchange concluded. DIN was done at May IPE +$5.75 cif Hamburg and a FOD done at May IPE +$4.75 cif France.

Barge activity for both diesel and heating was moderate. Traders said heating oil was steady around May IPE +50 cents fob AR and diesel around May IPE +$11, with 2,000 tonnes getting sold in the morning at +$10.50.
